title: Space Planning and Layout Design
text: Planning and organizing spaces to ensure better functionality, movement, and efficient use of available areas. Creating layouts that balance comfort, practicality, and aesthetics.

title: Concept Development and Theme Selection
text: Developing a design concept based on the client's requirements, preferences, and lifestyle. Establishing a theme, mood, and visual direction that gives the space a unique identity.

title: Material and Finish Selection
text: Selecting suitable materials, textures, colours, and finishes for floors, walls, ceilings, and furniture. Ensuring durability, functionality, and visual harmony throughout the space.

title: Technical Drawings and Documentation
text: Preparing detailed working drawings, furniture layouts, electrical plans, ceiling plans, and construction details. Providing accurate technical information to guide contractors and execution teams.

title: 3D Modelling and Visualisation
text: Creating 3D models and realistic renders to help clients visualise the proposed design before execution. Communicating materials, colours, furniture, lighting, and spatial arrangements effectively.

title: Site Execution and Project Coordination
text: Supervising the implementation of the design and coordinating with contractors, vendors, and other professionals. Ensuring that the work follows the approved drawings, materials, quality, and timeline.

title: Styling and Final Decoration
text: Adding the finishing touches through artwork, accessories, plants, rugs, curtains, and decorative elements. Bringing all design components together to create a complete, balanced, and welcoming space.

title: Client Meetings and Requirement Understanding
text: Conducting meetings with clients to understand their needs, preferences, lifestyle, budget, and project expectations. Discussing design concepts, presenting proposals, gathering feedback, and ensuring the design aligns with the client's vision.
